description.en: Diictodon feliceps-inspired tusked morph, presented as a static whole-animal reconstruction. Tusks do not establish sex; posture, soft tissues and colour are artistic. Revision r002 retains the recorded origin-only scope.
description.zh: 双犬齿兽 Diictodon feliceps 启发的具獠牙形态静态复原，獠牙不被解释为确定性别；姿态、软组织和颜色为艺术推断。r002保留记录的仅原点修订范围。

reference_credits.title: Geometric morphometric analysis of an ontogenetic cranial series of the Permian dicynodont Diictodon feliceps
reference_credits.original_scope: Short cranial profile/cheek region and ontogeny/morphotype limits; specimen skulls compressed/damaged in some cases.

reference_credits.title: Functional aspects of the postcranial anatomy of the Permian dicynodont Diictodon and their ecological implications
reference_credits.original_scope: Cylindrical body, short limbs, fore/hind limb orientations and long wide manus/blunt claws. Full PDF not obtained; access denial not bypassed.
